Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

parents noun

also parent, a parent, folks (one’s parents), my folks

classical

Traupman 24: parent parēns, parentis m./f.

parentēs, parentum m.

noun, third declension

Most often plural; the singular parēns is a father or a mother (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • facit parentēs bonitās, nōn necessitās

    it is kindness that makes parents, not necessityPhaedr. 3.15.18

See also children, family, father.

SourcesLewis & Short: parens

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 24.
